_what: Suggesting zooms from pointer telemetry (read-data/auto-zoom.mjs). The telemetry is a sidecar of samples normalised to the captured source (`space: normalized-source`). The pointer is sampled every `step_seconds`; a dwell is a stretch where it stays within `radius` of where it settled for at least `least_ms` (and at most `most_ms`, after which a new one starts). A click inside a dwell makes it one `strength` band stronger. `bands` give the strength by duration, `levels` the zoom each strength asks for, and `merge_gap_ms` joins suggestions that follow each other closely. `export_flags` are the command-line words that hand a telemetry file and the suggestions to a compositor; `{file}` and `{zooms}` are filled.
